mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal(goal_name, user_id, label_id, expiration_time, clock_in_count, target_clock_in_count, clock_in_cycle, remark) VALUES(#{goal.goalName}, #{userId}, #{goal.labelId}, #{goal.expirationTime}, #{goal.clockInCount}, #{goal.targetClockInCount}, #{goal.clockInCycle}, #{goal.remark})

UPDATE goal SET clock_in_time = #{clockInTime}, clock_in_count = #{goal.clockInCount} WHERE id = #{goal.id} AND user_id = #{userId}

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM goal WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
